description_en: Queries the data snapshot of an extension point based on the ID of a message in DataWorks OpenEvent when the related extension point event is triggered
description_zh: 根据DataWorks开放消息的消息ID，查询触发扩展点事件时的扩展点数据快照
name: GetIDEEventDetail

parameters.help_en: The message ID in DataWorks OpenEvent. You can obtain the ID from a received message when an extension point event is triggered
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks开放消息的消息ID。当触发扩展点事件后，您可以从接收到的事件消息中获取消息ID。

<props="china">消息格式，可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/215367.html。</props>
parameters.name: message_id

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can obtain the ID from the message
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以通过解析DataWorks开放消息获取空间ID
parameters.name: project_id
